key_decisions.after: Peter got up and went with them. When he arrived, they took him to the upstairs room. All the widows stood beside him, weeping and showing him the tunics and other clothing Dorcas had made while she was with them.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves privacy, posture, prayer, body, command, and physical sequence.

key_decisions.after: Peter sent everyone out, knelt down, and prayed. Turning toward the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up.” She opened her eyes, saw Peter, and sat up.
